title: Classification Of Industries
definition: The systematic categorization of manufacturing and economic enterprises based on raw materials used, capital investment, ownership structure, output nature, and market orientation.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding structural transformation of the Indian economy, industrial policy evolution (IDRA 1951, MSME definitions), regional imbalances, and inclusive growth strategies in Prelims and GS Paper III (Mains).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Classification Of Industries.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Sectors of Indian Economy (Primary, Secondary, Tertiary)
